summary: The candidate fixes the two previously reported control-plane counterexamples and passes its regressions, but a new ABA race lets an older successful probe clear a new failure generation after session re-registration resets the failure counter. The underlying cause of the original distributed transfer failures remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: 2 failed, 10 passed, 3 subtests passed; default probing was false and a stale successful probe cleared a newer N+1 failure.
Candidate regression suite: 12 passed, 3 subtests passed.
A probe snapshot at count 1, followed by registration clearing state and a new first failure at count 1, allowed the stale successful probe to erase the new blacklist and counter.

gpu_execution.evidence: Prepared host exposes one AMD gfx950 GPU; the reported NVIDIA/XCCL multi-node RoCEv2 topology was unavailable. The reviewed defect is deterministic CPU control-plane state handling.

remaining_counterexamples: ABA race: re-registration deletes the failure counter; a subsequent failure restarts at the same count, so an older successful probe can clear the new failure generation.
The recurring transfer failures in the reported 5P3D GLM5.2 NVIDIA/XCCL RoCEv2 deployment may continue because their underlying cause is neither identified nor corrected.
remaining_limitations: The original 5-prefill/3-decode GLM5.2 workload and weights were unavailable.
The NVIDIA CUDA/XCCL multi-node RoCEv2 environment was unavailable; the host has one AMD gfx950 GPU.
No native source changed, so no native library was rebuilt. Mooncake imported from installed site-packages while reviewed SGLang Python imported from the checkout.
